editor.premise: A working morning compressed into coffee, getting ready, exercise, and the journey to a desk.

chapters.name: Early home routine
chapters.purpose: Establish the morning through coffee, tidying, and a brief laptop session.

chapters.name: Getting ready
chapters.purpose: Compress grooming and packing into a continuous preparation sequence.

chapters.name: First journey
chapters.purpose: Move from home to the exercise destination.

chapters.name: Studio workout
chapters.purpose: Establish the destination, then sample successive exercises.

chapters.name: Post-workout refresh
chapters.purpose: Reset for work through another tightly compressed grooming sequence.

chapters.name: Coffee and commute
chapters.purpose: Reward the workout, then carry the morning toward work.

chapters.name: Starting work
chapters.purpose: Complete the morning's progression by settling into the laptop.

captions.note: Small white time-and-activity labels persist across fast cuts, usually centered; the opening adds a higher title, with occasional extra annotations.

editor.notes: Keep fixed-camera routines chronological, cutting waits rather than removing whole steps. Alternate low-angle travel views with foot-level inserts. Let labels span cuts. Music boundaries are approximate: isolated detections may reflect masking rather than deliberate stops.
